tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Fetch detailed information for a specific portfolio company by name or slug (params: name — defaults to first portfolio company) -> {id, name, description, initial_investment_year, leadership, investment_journey, website, jobs_url}

name.description: Company name or identifier substring (e.g. 'Amperity', 'Amazon', 'A-Alpha Bio')

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description: Fetch the full text and details of an insight article or podcast episode (params: url — defaults to latest insight) -> {title, date, author, url, content}

url.description: Direct URL of the insight article (e.g. 'https://www.madrona.com/celebrating-highspot/')

tools.name: get_team_member
tools.description: Fetch the full biography, title, department, and social links for a specific team member (params: name or url — defaults to first investor) -> {name, role, bio, social_links, profile_url}

name.description: Name of the team member (e.g. 'Scott Jacobson', 'Matt McIlwain')

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Browse and filter Madrona portfolio companies by sector category, status, and investment stage (params: category, status, stage, navigate=true) -> navigates to filtered portfolio; navigate:false returns {filters, count, companies: [{id, name, description, initial_investment_year, leadership, investment_journey, website, jobs_url}]}

status.description: Company status filter: 'active', 'exit', or '' for all

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the filtered companies page (defaults to true)

tools.name: list_insights
tools.description: List latest articles, podcasts, news, and perspectives from Madrona (params: category, navigate=true) -> navigates to insights feed; navigate:false returns {category, count, insights: [{title, url, date, author, category_classes}]}

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the insights page (defaults to true)

tools.name: list_team
tools.description: List Madrona team members and partners by department/group (params: section, navigate=true) -> navigates to team section; navigate:false returns {section, count, members: [{name, role, department, section_id, profile_url, photo_url}]}

section.description: Department section to filter by (defaults to 'all')

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the team page in the browser (defaults to true)

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Madrona content including companies, team members, and insights (params: query, post_type, navigate=true) -> navigates to search results; navigate:false returns {query, post_type, count, results: [{title, url, snippet, type}]}

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the search results page in the browser (defaults to true)

post_type.description: Optional filter by post type: 'portfolio-companies', 'team-profiles', 'post' (insights), or '' for all

tools.name: start_newsletter_subscription
tools.description: Pre-fill and initiate the newsletter signup form on the page (params: email) -> {status, email, action_url, message}
